connector.name: Geowire
connector.registryDescription: Place search, directions, isochrones & area analysis across 10 map providers. No API key to start.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the geowire account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables the Google Maps Platform provider (BYOK). Without it, GeoWire runs OpenStreetMap-only with no key required.

env.name: YELP_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables Yelp Fusion for US/Western business data — ratings, reviews, price, categories.

env.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional (free). Enables US Census demographics (population, median age, household income) for area analysis.

env.name: FOURSQUARE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables Foursquare global POI data — categories, photos, popularity.

env.name: GEOWIRE_INTERNAL_CSV
env.description: Optional. Path to a CSV of your own places to register as a priority provider.

env.name: GEOWIRE_CONFIG
env.description: Optional. Path to a geowire.config.yaml for advanced routing/budget/provider settings.
